title: 第19章 出卖名单上有我的名字第20章 第三道影子
slug: 幕后黑手我的词条邪到发癫
content_zh:
对巡捕房你可以抗拒从严，伪装欺骗，逍遥法外。
毕竟披着官皮的再黑，也是披着皮，得装个人样子。
但对上黑帮，上述思路都是找死！
因为混黑帮的过程，就是脱掉皮的过程，混得越高级，身上的人皮脸皮撕得就越干净，只剩下血淋淋的野兽模样。
而野兽讲究的是直觉，遵从的是原始和本能，就像狗鼻子闻到味儿，你越跑它越追，直到咬上或者咬死你。
对付人，可以选择玩脑子捉迷藏；
对上兽，就只能白刀子进红刀子出了。
冯睦虽然黑涩会的片子看的少，但这粗浅的道理他是懂的。
因为所有黑涩会片子刨除掉教育意义外，其实都在讲同一个故事——以暴制暴，以血还血。
冯睦回屋后，没有立刻修炼锻体操，而是坐在书桌前，拿出纸笔来捋顺思路。
死者郑航父亲——青狼帮头目，死咬住案子不放的罪魁祸首。
那天案发现场，疑似二当家的人物——看起来颇有脑子，是他制定了嫌疑人名单范围吗？
校门口的混混，手上的单子内容？
案发现场的捕头队长，任由青狼帮这么查，打脸了啊。
郑航案件盖棺定论否，巡捕房后续动作？
王薇母亲死在医院，对整件事的影响？
……
因为不晓得这些人物的名字，冯睦在纸上只能用一些间接称谓来标注。
一刻钟后，冯睦重重在几个名字后面依次打上八叉，心头隐约勾画出一个计划轮廓。
“我没能力制止青狼帮调查，毕竟父爱是阻拦不住的，这个问题无解，那就只能解决出问题的人了。”

冯睦在纸上圈注名字的顺序，就是他的解题步骤。
敲门声打断冯睦的思绪，母亲王秀丽喊他出来吃饭。
冯睦应了声，习惯性的把纸撕碎就着铁珠和水咽入肚子。
吃饭间。
冯睦漫不经心问了句：“爸还不回来，这回的案子拖的够久的。”
见冯睦罕见的关心询问他爹，王秀丽高兴的把知道的都吐露出来。
她说：“应该还得有段时间，不止你爹，说是巡捕房大部分人手都撒去城西了，已经摸到线索了，估摸着再过两周就能逮到人了。”
冯睦一边嚼饭一边又问：“要抓的人，是妹妹说的那个啥[命运]吗？”
王秀丽也没啥保密意识，或者说，巡捕房本就是个人多眼杂，四处漏风的地方。
王秀丽回答道：“嗯，好像锁定了四五个人的踪迹了，要是全逮住，巡捕房上下都能立个大功。”
冯睦舔舔嘴唇：“都锁定人了，还不收网抓人？”
王秀丽：“说是可能还有接头人没暴露，等着钓大鱼，我也没太听懂。”
冯睦心头登时悚然，又想到了系统每日提示的[奖励已发送，请注意查收]。
他喝口水润下嗓子：“这种组织穷凶极恶，巡捕房有把握抓人吗，不会出危险吧？”
王秀丽脸上也露出丝丝担忧，但还是笑道：“应该没问题，我听着你爹话里话外的意思，这次行动巡捕房把握蛮大的。”
冯睦心下又是一沉，面上则不动声色哦了一声，把碗里的饭扒拉干净才回房间。
反手锁门，冯睦一边往嘴里塞铁珠，一边思忖：“巡捕房如此有把握，[命运]那批人八成是凉凉了。”
“希望里面不会有给我送货的快递员，应该不能有吧~”
content_en:
You can resist the strictness of the police station, pretend to deceive, and get away with it.
After all, no matter how dark a person is when he is wearing official skin, he is still wearing official skin and has to pretend to be a person.
But when it comes to gangsters, all the above ideas are seeking death!
Because the process of being a gangster is the process of taking off the skin. The higher the level of gangsterism, the cleaner the human skin is torn off, leaving only the appearance of a bloody beast.
Beasts, on the other hand, pay attention to intuition and follow primitive and instinctive behaviors. Just like a dog smells something with its nose, it will chase you more and more until it bites you or bites you to death.
When dealing with people, you can choose to play hide-and-seek in your head;
Against the beast, you can only use the white knife to enter and the red knife to exit.
Although Feng Mu has watched few Heisehui movies, he understands this simple truth.
Because apart from the educational significance, all black society films are actually telling the same story - to fight violence with violence, to fight blood with blood.
After Feng Mu returned to the house, he did not practice gymnastics immediately. Instead, he sat at his desk and took out a pen and paper to smooth out his thoughts.
The father of the deceased Zheng Hang, the leader of the Green Wolf Gang, was the culprit who refused to let go of the case.
At the crime scene that day, the suspected second-in-command seemed to have a lot of brains. Was he the one who drew up the list of suspects?
The gangster at the school gate, what is the list in his hand?
The head catcher at the scene of the crime was a slap in the face for allowing the Green Wolf Gang to investigate like this.
Is the Zheng Hang case concluded? What is the follow-up action of the patrol room?
Wang Wei's mother died in the hospital. What impact did it have on the whole thing?
…
Because he didn't know the names of these characters, Feng Mu could only use some indirect titles to mark them on the paper.
A quarter of an hour later, Feng Mu marked eight points after several names one after another, vaguely sketching the outline of a plan in his mind.
"I have no ability to stop the Green Wolf Gang from investigating. After all, a father's love cannot be stopped. There is no solution to this problem, so we can only solve the problem."
The order in which Feng Mu circled the names on the paper was his problem-solving steps.
A knock on the door interrupted Feng Mu's thoughts, and his mother, Wang Xiuli, called him out for dinner.
Feng Mu responded, habitually tearing up the paper and swallowing the iron beads and water.
Dining room.
Feng Mu asked casually: "Dad hasn't come back yet. This case has been delayed for a long time."
Seeing Feng Mu's rare concern for asking about his father, Wang Xiuli happily revealed everything she knew.
She said: "It will take some time. Not only your father, but most of the police officers have been sent to the west of the city. They have already found clues. I think they will be arrested in another two weeks."
While chewing his rice, Feng Mu asked again: "Is the person I want to arrest the [destiny] that my sister mentioned?"
Wang Xiuli also has no sense of confidentiality, or in other words, the patrol room is a place where people have many eyes and leaks.
Wang Xiuli replied: "Well, it seems that the traces of four or five people have been locked. If they are all caught, everyone in the patrol room will make a great contribution."
Feng Mu licked his lips: "We've already targeted people, why don't you close the net and arrest them?"
Wang Xiuli: "It's said that there may be contacts who haven't been exposed, waiting to catch big fish, but I don't quite understand it."
Feng Mu felt horrified and thought of the system's daily reminder of [Reward has been sent, please check it].
He drank water to moisten his throat: "This kind of organization is extremely vicious. Is the patrol room sure of arresting people? Is there any danger?"
Wang Xiuli also showed a trace of worry on her face, but she still smiled and said: "It should be no problem. I heard what your father meant, and the patrol room is quite sure of this operation."
Feng Mu's heart sank again, and with a calm expression on his face, he cleared the rice in the bowl before returning to the room.
Locking the door with his backhand, Feng Mu stuffed iron beads into his mouth and thought: "The patrol room is so sure, [the fate] of those people is probably in the cold."
"I hope there won't be a courier inside to deliver my goods, there shouldn't be any~"
